subject: Metrics triage: leadership readout + owner commitments (QBR prep)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: QBR metrics triage — initial data and asks

Team — kicking off a tight triage window to get our QBR readout locked with owners and commitments. Acme asked for a compact dashboard covering: P50/P95 latency, per-token cost trend (30d), platform uptime (30d) with incident notes, and customer usage by seat/region.

Quick notes from the raw numbers:
- Latency: P50 stable at ~85ms but P95 sporadically spikes to 680–900ms during peak bursts (notably 2027-09-22 14:03 UTC incident).
- Cost: token cost per 1k tokens is ~ $0.95 after the September quantization roll; effective unit cost up 6% vs July due to higher churn and lower batching.
- Uptime: 99.92% last 30d; two 12–18 minute degradations due to autoscaling flaps (linked).
- Usage: Acme growth +18% M/M; heavy tail of short sessions increasing RPS variability.

Asks:
1) Laura — can you drop a one-page snapshot with P95 histogram and incident timeline by EOD 10/2? Attach as xlsx.
2) Vivek — can you confirm whether autoscaler tune from 9/15 was rolled to prod and if rollback is safe? 10/3 EOD.
3) Jonas — please compile leadership readout and assign owners for any mitigation actions.

Elena, any specific formatting Acme prefers? We want to keep exec summary under one page.

--
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

- Owner commitments for three workstreams: autoscale tuning (Vivek), batching/cache policy review (Irene), and cost levers (Marissa).

Action assignments (tentative):
- Laura B: KPI snapshot + incident timeline (attachment) — due 10/02 EOD.
- Vivek K: Confirm autoscaler roll status and recommended config — due 10/03 EOD.
- Irene C: Short proposal for prefix/KV caching policy changes we can test with Acme (include estimated token-savings) — due 10/05.

Elena — we'll share a one-pager and the supporting xlsx. If procurement or legal needs any pre-read, loop them in and we'll add the appendix.

Attaching the KPI snapshot and an incident timeline per Hannah's request. Attachment notes:
- 20271003-kpi-snapshot.xlsx (tabs: Summary, LatencyHistograms, IncidentTimeline, CostBreakdown)
- Key callouts on the Summary tab (first sheet).

Highlights:
- P95 spikes correlate with sudden short-session surges in AP and US-east; stack traces point to increased context-switch overhead on quantized kernels during burst windows.
- The autoscaler experienced three fast up/down cycles on 9/22; I flagged the control-loop PID damping as a likely contributor.
- Estimated immediate savings from enabling prefix caching for this workload: ~9–12% token-cost reduction (conservative).

Next steps: I recommend we present the Summary + one-sentence mitigation plan to Acme, then attach the full xlsx as appendix.

Subject: Metrics triage readout + owner commitments — QBR prep (final)

Team — final readout for Acme prep. Putting the one-pager text in-line for review; Laura's xlsx attached and the runbook draft is in Drive (link below). Please acknowledge owners and dates.

Executive summary (one paragraph):
Acme's QBR snapshot shows stable median latency (P50 ~85ms) but elevated P95s during short-session surges driven by regional burst patterns and autoscaler oscillation. Immediate mitigation: (1) tune autoscaler damping to prevent rapid up/down cycles, (2) enable conservative prefix caching for heavy-tail sessions, and (3) run a 2-week dedicated-burst pilot if Acme agrees to a short PO amendment. Combined, we expect to reduce P95 spikes and lower effective token costs by ~8–11% within two release cycles.

Owner commitments (confirmed):
- Vivek Kulkarni — Autoscaler rollback/confirm and tuning plan; deliverable: config + rollback checklist — due 2027-10-03 EOD.
- Laura Bennett — Final KPI xlsx (attached) + incident timeline for appendix — delivered.
- Irene Choi — Prefix/KV caching test plan (A/B with one tenant) + estimated token savings — due 2027-10-05.
- Marissa Cole — Cost delta analysis + recommended short-term cost levers — due 2027-10-04.
- Hannah Schmitt — Draft one-pager for Acme and runbook appendix (qbr-runbook-v1.md) — due 2027-10-03 EOD.

Links and appendices:
- KPI snapshot (attached): 20271003-kpi-snapshot.xlsx
- Runbook draft (Drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3CkpiSnapshot
- HubSpot record: HS-93482

Elena — if procurement proceeds with a two-week burst pilot PO, we'll coordinate SOW language and expected SLO adjustments.

Please reply with a one-line ack once your action is started.

Best,
